lead: Two records, each graded against what it competes with: our rest-of-season order, graded week by week against ESPN and the week's published projection, and our draft board against ADP.
weeklyWhat: Our rest-of-season order, graded week by week against ESPN and the week's published projection
draftWhat: Our draft board against ADP, on the season's points so far
setRulePhone: Each week's order is graded as set, never as refreshed after.
gradesLater: grades once every game's stats are in
espnBasis: ESPN's is its own public PPR projection, read before the week's first kickoff.
espnReadAfter: ESPN's projection this week was read after our rest-of-season order was set, still before the first kickoff.
espnUnread: ESPN's projection was not read before this week's first kickoff, so the week is graded against the week's published projection alone.
noYardstick: No yardstick was read before this week's first kickoff, so the week is graded on its own order alone.
waiting: This record is written by the next nightly run.
draftPositions: Each position is graded on its own, All by players graded.
draftLeftOut: Kickers and defenses are left out, and a player past his bye has one game fewer counted.
draftScale: Order matched is how closely an order ranked the players to the season's finish so far: 1.00 is the same order, 0.00 no closer than chance, below 0.00 the order runs backwards.
draftChart: Order matched, season to date, through each week
leagueRow: Your league's row grades its rostered players and both lineups.
